## What changes and why

Explain the concrete documentation or public experience problem and the proposed result.

## Evidence and scope

Link the primary source or public case. Include source/version and relevant time boundaries. Mark inference, synthetic examples and unresolved points explicitly.

## Validation

Describe the checks actually performed (links, rendering, accessibility or reproducible behavior). Do not call an unrun check passed.

- [ ] Delivered, privately tested, planned and unknown remain distinct.
- [ ] No credentials, personal identifiers, private investigations or withheld raw evidence are included.
- [ ] Any third-party content has an appropriate sharing right.
- [ ] The change makes no unsupported safety, identity, price, partnership or delivery claim.
